text:
iona_cs: Quick status — Sable private cutover tomorrow. A few ops questions around log forwarding, IAM, and KMS grants before we flip.
kevin_netops: Current state: their VPC blocks outbound to our collector. Need CIDR + ports.
iona_cs: Sable provided CIDR 10.44.0.0/16. Collector endpoints: 10.9.8.7:514/udp and 10.9.8.7:6514/tcp (TLS).
kevin_netops: I'll land a terraform egress rule allowing 10.44.0.0/16 -> 10.9.8.7 ports 514/udp and 6514/tcp. ETA: PR today.
maya_sre: For log export SA, create a short-lived principal with roles/logging.logWriter and scoped KMS crypto access only to the specific key. No IAM roles beyond that.
liam_eng: They asked about customer-managed KMS keys. We support cross-account grants. Need the key ARN and their policy snippet. I posted an example below.
emily_cs: Audit retention requirement: Sable wants 1 year for compliance. Can we confirm lifecycle on their bucket is 365d and accessible by e-discovery?
onboarding-bot: Playbook reminder: Step 6.3 "Enable audit export and set 365d lifecycle" assigned to emily_cs by 2175000100.
liam_eng: KMS policy example (AWS) — share with their security:
```
{
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDFWOOD_RUNTIME_ACCOUNT:role/redwood-runner"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01"
    }
  ]
}
```
kevin_netops: Note: their NGFW does DPI and may rewrite UDP syslog packets. We should prioritize TLS (6514) to avoid dropped fields.
iona_cs: Agreed — request Sable enable TLS syslog by default and keep UDP 514 as fallback for the ramp window.
emily_cs: Risk callout: if cutover slips beyond next Tuesday, CS flagged as renewal-risk. Any blockers in PR/KMS policy stalls will escalate.
jenna_sales: I can join a focused enablement call — propose tomorrow 10am PT with Sable-sec, their infra, plus our infra and SRE.
maya_sre: Available. Proposed agenda: review firewall PR, SA creation pattern, KMS grant template, audit export validation, and rollback plan. 30-40m.
iona_cs: Action items: kevin 1 open terraform PR for egress rule (due EOD). liam 1 post KMS policy examples and confirm ARN format (due EOD). emily 1 validate audit export lifecycle on their bucket (before call). jenna 1 send calendar invite. I'll produce an enablement checklist during the call to capture feedback.
kevin_netops: PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-512 1 please review.
liam_eng: KMS snippets uploaded: https://drive.redwood/sable-kms-examples 1 includes cross-account and GCP CMEK examples.
emily_cs: Confirmed retention: Sable will set 395 days to cover buffer.
jenna_sales: Invite sent. Calendar link in thread.
iona_cs: We'll capture any friction for docs (especially KMS cross-account templates and quick fallback for log loss). Please react with :thumbsup: once you finish your item.
